_comment: Per-repo relay config, config not code (mirrors adapters/ci-watch/roster.json's pattern). A repo NOT listed under `repos` is out of scope by construction: github-relay never ingests or comments on it, fail-closed like tools/maintenance-train/repo_config.py's allowlist. `default` supplies any field a per-repo entry omits. `outbound` gates adapters/github-relay/watch.py:post_issue_comment: off=skip silently, dry-run=write the would-be comment to report.md + stderr but never call `gh issue comment`, live=actually post. NEVER set `outbound` to "live" here -- flipping a repo to live outbound posting is an explicit operator decision made on the host after reviewing dry-run output in report.md, not something this adapter ships pre-armed for.
